# 1 Enoch Chapter 87 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams — Animal Apocalypse

---

**87:1** And-I-saw-one-of-those-four-white-figures, that-it-came-forth-from-that-place-and-three-were-with-it.

**87:2** And-those-three-that-had-last-come-forth grasped-me-by-my-hand-and-took-me-up, away-from-the-generations-of-the-earth, and-raised-me-up-to-a-lofty-place, and-showed-me-a-tower-raised-high-above-the-earth, and-all-the-hills-were-lower.

**87:3** And-one-said-to-me: 'Remain-here-till-thou-seest everything-that-befalls-those-elephants, camels, and-asses, and-the-stars-and-the-oxen, and-all-of-them.'

**87:4** And-I-saw one-of-those-four-white-figures, how-he-seized-that-first-star which-had-fallen-from-heaven, and-bound-it-hand-and-foot-and-cast-it-into-an-abyss: now-that-abyss-was-narrow-and-deep-and-horrible-and-dark.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Chapter 87 depicts the four archangels (Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, Suryal/Phanuel — here as white figures) descending to deal with the fallen Watchers. Enoch himself is lifted up to observe the action (cf. ch. 14 where he ascends to the divine throne). The binding of the first fallen star = the binding of Semyaza (cf. 10:11-13).*
